title: Generative AI and Structural Change in Crowdsourced Music Information Platforms
description: Research report, software, provenance records, and publication figures examining how generative AI may alter provenance, governance, and knowledge production on crowdsourced music-information platforms. Observed archives, controlled comparisons, synthetic method checks, and assumption-driven scenarios are explicitly separated.

creators.name: Sun, RunJie
